Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

rbcb (development version)

  • Fix olinda_get_currency(): the PTAX OData API now requires dates as MM-DD-YYYY (Issue #67)
  • sgs() and get_series(as = "ts") no longer fail when the SGS website is down (Issue #66):
    • sgs() now defaults to load_info = FALSE; the metadata page returns HTTP 502.
    • get_series(as = "ts") infers the series frequency from the dates instead of the metadata.
    • sgs() rejects invalid codes (zero, negative, non-numeric) directly.
  • Daily SGS series can be downloaded again without start_date (Issue #64). The API limits daily series to 10-year windows, so longer periods are downloaded in 10-year windows and combined.
  • SGS series that return a period for each value (TR 226, TBF 253) keep the end of the period in a new enddate column, in rbcb_get() and in get_series(as = "tibble") / "data.frame". Before, the end date was dropped. as = "xts" and "ts" raise an error when two periods share a start date (Issue #82).
  • get_series(as = "text") returns the raw JSON again: one string for one series, or a named list for several series. Before, it returned NULL. Periods longer than 10 years are joined into one JSON array, as in python-bcb (Issue #72).
  • SGS series are always returned oldest-first. With last = N, some series (e.g. Selic 1178) came newest-first, so as = "ts" had a wrong start and reversed values (Issue #73).
  • The RStudio addins rbcb_search() and rbcb_dataset() work again: dataset search uses the CKAN v3 API of dadosabertos.bcb.gov.br (Issue #68).
